summary.text: Josh Bray is a Republican state representative from Kentucky House District 71 who has served since 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
His career experience includes operating a beef farm.

paragraphs.text: Josh Bray took office in the Kentucky House on January 1, 2021, succeeding R. Travis Brenda.

In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Banking and Insurance Committee, the Health and Family Services Committee, and the Local Government Committee, and he is vice chair of the Appropriations and Revenue Committee.
